description: Rewire the student/vendor transactional pages to Supabase: Profile (orders/favorites/reviews scoped to auth.uid(), review submit, restored /login redirect, real changePassword), OrderStatus (real order read, review submit, remove the sessionStorage+timer, student-cancel = Phase-C placeholder), Dashboard (real owned-vendor orders fetch, categories from context, store/menu edits via VendorContext, order action buttons = Phase-C placeholders), and Cart (lowercase role, placeOrder = Phase-C placeholder). Depends on FEAT-001 (auth) and FEAT-002 (VendorContext + categories). No direct order/order_items writes to Supabase anywhere.
steps: src/pages/Profile.jsx: remove `import { vendors as ALL_VENDORS } from '../data/vendors'` (use useVendors(); feed real vendor rows into the existing toVendor adapter) and remove `import { ACTIVE_ORDERS, PAST_ORDERS, FAVORITES, PENDING_REVIEWS, PAST_REVIEWS } from '../data/studentSample'`. Remove PREVIEW_USER and restore the redirect: `if (!auth.user) return <Navigate to='/login' replace />`. Switch the vendor-role redirect to lowercase ('vendor'). Replace user.name->user.full_name, user.avatar->user.avatar_url; role badge lowercase.

Profile orders: supabase.from('orders').select('id, code, vendor_id, status, total, placed_at, order_items(name, qty, unit_price)').eq('student_id', user.id).order('placed_at', { ascending:false }). Active tab = status in (pending, preparing, ready); Past tab = (completed, cancelled). Adapt each row to the shape the Orders component renders (id<-code, vendor<-resolved vendor name via useVendors().getVendor, items<-order_items mapped to {qty,name}, total, status mapped through the existing STATUS_PILL labels, map preparing->Preparing/Accepted).

Profile favorites: supabase.from('favorites').select('vendor_id').eq('student_id', user.id); resolve each vendor_id via useVendors().getVendor for the VendorCard. Remove-favorite -> supabase.from('favorites').delete().eq('student_id', user.id).eq('vendor_id', vendorId).

Profile reviews: past = supabase.from('reviews').select('id, vendor_id, rating, text, created_at, ordered_summary').eq('student_id', user.id); pending = the student's COMPLETED orders that have no matching review row yet (compute from completed orders + the set of reviewed order_ids). Each pending entry carries its order_id (uuid) and vendor_id. Review SUBMIT from the pending 'Write a review' form -> supabase.from('reviews').insert({ vendor_id, order_id, rating, text }) (send ONLY those four fields; student_id/author_name/ordered_summary are DB/trigger-filled). On success move the item from pending to past.

Profile account settings: pass the real auth.changePassword/auth.deleteAccount through (FEAT-001 made changePassword real and deleteAccount an honest throw). Adapt the changePassword call to the Supabase signature (it takes { next }); the form's current-password field can stay in the UI but changePassword only needs the new password.

src/pages/OrderStatus.jsx: remove loadOrder/sessionStorage and the setTimeout auto-advance useEffect. Fetch supabase.from('orders').select('id, code, vendor_id, status, total, pickup_name, note, order_items(name, qty, unit_price)').eq('id', id).single() (RLS: student sees own). Derive the displayed step from the real status (map DB 'preparing' to the UI's 'accepted' step). Resolve the vendor via useVendors().getVendor(order.vendor_id). Adapt the DB row into the order object the JSX reads: keep the UUID for the review insert but display id=code; vendorName=vendor?.name; lines=order_items.map(oi=>({name:oi.name, qty:oi.qty, price:oi.unit_price})); total, pickupName<-pickup_name, note. Keep the 'Order not found' state for a missing/RLS-denied row.

OrderStatus completed-state 'Leave a review': replace the empty /* TODO */ onClick with a rating+text form that inserts supabase.from('reviews').insert({ vendor_id: order.vendor_id, order_id: <order UUID>, rating, text }). Student-cancel button (handleCancel): replace with a clearly-marked Phase-C TODO placeholder (// TODO(Phase C): POST /api/orders/{id}/transition {to:'cancelled'}) — show an informational message / disabled state; DO NOT remove sessionStorage (it's gone) and DO NOT write to Supabase.

src/pages/Dashboard.jsx: delete SEED_ORDERS and SEED_HISTORY. Replace `import { categories } from '../data/vendors'` with the context categories (useVendors().categories) used in the ItemDialog and ProfileTab category <select>s. Confirm the store/menu edit callbacks still call VendorContext (updateVendorInfo/setPreorderEnabled/saveMenuItem/setItemAvailable/deleteMenuItem) with vid and the item shape {id,name,desc,price,category,available,image} — these are now Supabase-backed from FEAT-002.

Dashboard orders: fetch supabase.from('orders').select('id, code, pickup_name, status, total, placed_at, cancel_reason, order_items(name, qty)').eq('vendor_id', currentVendorId).order('placed_at', { ascending:false }), adapt into the shapes OrdersTab/DashboardTab consume (id<-code, name<-pickup_name, items<-order_items joined as 'qty× name' comma-separated, total, status, placedAt<-Date.parse(placed_at); split completed into history with daysAgo). The order action buttons (accept/ready/complete/reject via changeStatus/reject) become clearly-marked Phase-C TODO placeholders — either disable them with a 'Managed by the order service (coming soon)' note, or keep an explicitly-labelled UI-only optimistic update; NO direct Supabase order status write either way. The finance report and CSV export compute from the fetched read-only orders.

src/pages/Cart.jsx: change user?.role === 'Student' to 'student'. Replace the placeOrder body (FH- id gen + order object + sessionStorage.setItem('order-...') + navigate) with a clearly-marked Phase-C TODO placeholder that does NOT write to Supabase and does NOT fabricate a sessionStorage order: on submit show a clear 'Order placement is coming soon (handled by the order service)' inline message (or disabled confirm button) and keep the cart intact. Comment: // TODO(Phase C): POST /api/orders then navigate('/order/'+id). Leave CartContext unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Profile fetches orders/favorites/reviews from Supabase scoped to the logged-in student, submits reviews with only {vendor_id,order_id,rating,text}, redirects to /login when logged out, and no longer imports ALL_VENDORS/studentSample/PREVIEW_USER.

OrderStatus reads the real order via Supabase (no sessionStorage, no setTimeout timer), maps preparing->Accepted, submits a review on the completed state, and treats student-cancel as a Phase-C placeholder (no direct order write).

Dashboard has no SEED_ORDERS/SEED_HISTORY, sources categories from context, fetches real owned-vendor orders, routes store/menu edits through VendorContext, and leaves order action buttons as Phase-C placeholders (no direct order writes).
Cart uses lowercase role and a Phase-C placeholder placeOrder (no sessionStorage order blob, no Supabase order write).
verification: grep -rn "from('orders').insert\|from('orders').update\|from('order_items').insert\|sessionStorage" src/pages/Cart.jsx src/pages/Dashboard.jsx src/pages/OrderStatus.jsx  (no direct order writes / no cart sessionStorage order)
findings:
DONE. Build green (117 modules, exit 0 from the worktree root). All FEAT-003 verification greps pass: no studentSample|PREVIEW_USER|ALL_VENDORS in Profile.jsx; no sessionStorage|setTimeout in OrderStatus.jsx; no SEED_ORDERS|SEED_HISTORY in Dashboard.jsx; no from('orders').insert/.update, from('order_items').insert, or sessionStorage in Cart/Dashboard/OrderStatus. Committed locally on branch phase-b-frontend (staged only the 4 modified page files).

=== What changed (for FEAT-004) ===
All four transactional pages now read orders/order_items/reviews/favorites READ-ONLY from Supabase under RLS, scoped to the logged-in user. No client writes orders or order_items anywhere. Review INSERTs (Profile + OrderStatus) send ONLY { vendor_id, order_id, rating, text }.

src/pages/Profile.jsx: dropped ALL_VENDORS/studentSample/PREVIEW_USER and the toVendor() data adapter. Restored redirect: `if (!auth.loading && !auth.user) return <Navigate to='/login' replace/>`; vendor-role redirect is lowercase 'vendor'. user.full_name/user.avatar_url used throughout (EditProfile still calls updateUser with the camel keys name/avatar/mobile — FEAT-001's updateUser maps name->full_name, avatar->avatar_url). Orders: supabase.from('orders').select('id, code, vendor_id, status, total, placed_at, order_items(name, qty, unit_price)').eq('student_id', user.id); Active tab = status in (pending,preparing,ready), Past tab = (completed,cancelled); vendor name resolved via useVendors().getVendor; DB status mapped to the STATUS_PILL labels (preparing->'Preparing'). Favorites: select vendor_id -> resolve via getVendor; remove = delete eq student_id+vendor_id. Reviews: past from reviews table; pending = completed orders whose order uuid is NOT in the reviewed-order set; each pending item carries orderId(uuid)+vendorId; submit inserts the 4 fields then moves pending->past. Review EDIT of existing past reviews was removed (insert-only per design; the old savePast/Edit modal is gone). changePassword now called as changePassword({ next }) (Supabase signature) — the current-password field stays in the UI as a confirmation prompt only; logoutOthers is not supported by the client SDK.

src/pages/OrderStatus.jsx: removed loadOrder/sessionStorage and the setTimeout auto-advance. Fetches supabase.from('orders').select('id, code, vendor_id, status, total, pickup_name, note, order_items(name, qty, unit_price)').eq('id', id).single(). DB_STATUS_TO_STEP maps preparing->'accepted' (the tracker has no separate preparing step). order.uuid keeps the real UUID for the review insert while order.id displays the code. Added an inline ReviewForm (rating+text) on the completed state -> inserts { vendor_id, order_id:uuid, rating, text }. Student-cancel is now a DISABLED Phase-C placeholder button + info note (TODO(Phase C): POST /api/orders/{id}/transition {to:'cancelled'}) — no Supabase write, no sessionStorage. The cancel confirmation modal was removed. Kept the 'Order not found' state (also covers RLS-denied/empty). Added a brief 'Loading order…' state.

src/pages/Dashboard.jsx: deleted SEED_ORDERS/SEED_HISTORY and `import { categories } from '../data/vendors'`. categories now come from useVendors().categories and are threaded as a prop into MenuTab->ItemDialog and into ProfileTab (both category <select>s). Orders fetched read-only: supabase.from('orders').select('id, code, pickup_name, status, total, placed_at, cancel_reason, order_items(name, qty)').eq('vendor_id', currentVendorId).order placed_at desc; adapted to the OrdersTab/DashboardTab shapes (id<-code, name<-pickup_name, items<-'qty× name' joined, total, status, placedAt<-Date.parse, completed/cancelled split into history with daysAgo computed from placed_at). The accept/ready/complete (changeStatus) and reject buttons are kept as explicitly-labelled UI-ONLY optimistic updates with TODO(Phase C) comments — NO Supabase order-status write. Store/menu edits still route through VendorContext (updateVendorInfo/setPreorderEnabled/saveMenuItem/setItemAvailable/deleteMenuItem) unchanged. AccountTab now reads user.full_name (was user.name). NOTE: AccountTab.changePassword still passes { current, next, logoutOthers }; Supabase's updateUser ignores the extras (only password:next is used) so it's harmless — not touched since it's outside FEAT-003's step list, but FEAT-004 could simplify it if desired.

src/pages/Cart.jsx: role check is lowercase ('student'), pickup name seeded from user.full_name. placeOrder is now a Phase-C no-op placeholder (TODO(Phase C): POST /api/orders then navigate) — no sessionStorage, no Supabase write, cart stays intact. The confirm button is disabled with an inline 'Order placement is coming soon (handled by the order service)' message. Removed the now-unused useNavigate import.

=== For FEAT-004 ===
Remaining src/data references in the worktree: ZERO real imports. The ONLY hit is a stale COMMENT in src/components/ReviewsModal.jsx (line ~8: 'Placeholder reviews come from ../data/reviews.js.') — FEAT-004 must update that comment, then it is safe to delete src/data/vendors.js, src/data/reviews.js, src/data/studentSample.js. Verified: grep for data/vendors|data/reviews|data/studentSample across src/**/*.jsx returns only that comment.
Review insert contract (reuse in Admin if needed): send ONLY { vendor_id, order_id, rating, text }. orders/order_items are never written by the client — Admin's all-orders panel must stay READ-ONLY (no status mutation). supabase client import path from src/pages is '../lib/supabase'. useVendors() exposes categories/categoryName/getVendor; use getVendor(vendorId)?.name to resolve vendor names in admin lists.
